sceneConcept: A lean thirty-five-year-old Chinese last-train driver stands alone against a transparent background after his shift. Short parted black hair, brown eyes and tired shadows under the eyes accompany a restrained downward gaze. He is bareheaded, and his washed-out navy metro work shirt has short sleeves, no epaulettes, rank marks, badges or insignia, one open collar button, straight black trousers and black shoes. His shoulders finally slump and one hand holds a completely unlabelled clear plastic bottle of amber herbal tea low at his side. Soft even frontal studio light creates no platform, train, passengers, chimes, ghosts, writing or bright rim.
